name: B10-0074/2026 (The Left) – Attempted takeover of Lithuania’s public broadcaster and the threat to democracy in Lithuania
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the attempted takeover of Lithuania’s public broadcaster and the threat to democracy in Lithuania
part_text:
The European Parliament is worried about planned changes to Lithuania's public broadcaster, LRT. The changes could let politicians influence who runs it and how it is funded. The Parliament asks Lithuanian lawmakers to make sure any final rules keep LRT editorially independent, with fair hiring and firing and stable funding. It also asks them to consult journalists and civil society openly. The Parliament has no power to block the changes; it is stating its position.

- Nothing changes yet: the Lithuanian parliament postponed its final vote and is still working on the draft.
- It affects LRT, its journalists and Lithuanian citizens who rely on it for independent news.
- Next: a Council of Europe expert body visits Lithuania on 19–20 January 2026 to give an opinion.
